headline: 🐧 Linux Copy Fail 0-Day Escapes Containers, 🔴 cPanel Zero-Day Exploited Since February, 🇰🇵 DPRK PromptMink LLM Supply Chain
summary: A devastating Linux kernel zero-day (CVE-2026-31431) enables unprivileged root access and container escape via a 732-byte Python script. cPanel's auth bypass was exploited as a zero-day since February. North Korea's Famous Chollima group is pioneering LLM-optimized supply chain attacks through AI-generated commits.
